text:
alex.k: quick ask — I need a short-lived unwrap token to pull an HSM-wrapped customer API key for a hotfix deploy to staging. tagging @nicole-sec + @jordan-sre for approval. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2768

nicole-sec: who is the operator doing the deploy and what's the exact TTL you need? we prefer response-wrapped tokens over long-lived secrets. also include why this can't go through the normal deploy pipeline.

alex.k: operator is mike-eng, it's a manual emergency deploy (customer-facing timeout bug). need ~2 minutes TTL to unwrap and inject into the staging service container. reason: can't use normal pipeline because the staging k8s node group is isolated for this customer and our pipeline can't access that VPC.

jordan-sre: +1 on response wrapping. alternative would be to assume the staging-admin STS role via our CI role broker, but that requires a quick policy add and more lead time. response wrap sounds fastest.

mike-eng: I can do the unwrap and deploy. will not paste tokens into channels. will use local vault CLI and put the token into the pod as an env var at runtime only.

nicole-sec: ok, conditions: 1) TTL <= 120s (wrap-ttl). 2) Use Vault response-wrapping or AWS STS assume-role — prefer wrap. 3) Add `no-log: true` header to the deploy job and ensure the deployment agent doesn’t log env values (update log-filter if needed). 4) Create an audit comment in INF-2768 with the unwrap nonce and operator. can you confirm adherence?

alex.k: confirmed. plan: `vault write -wrap-ttl=120 -field=token secret/data/customer-x/hsm-unwrap` then `vault unwrap <token>` locally and inject into pod. will set CI header "X-No-Log: 1" on the deploy job. will post audit note and attach the unwrap nonce to the ticket.

sec-bot: Policy check: response-wrapping allowed for path `secret/data/customer-x/*` for approver group `eng-security`. No open policy violations detected.

nicole-sec: approving for this one-off. mike-eng, please do not store token in plaintext anywhere. after deploy, rotate the customer-side wrapped key if there was any exposure.

mike-eng: got it. will rotate and add rotation note to INF-2768. one question: do we want an automated log-filter rule for `X-No-Log` header so it’s enforced?

jordan-sre: yes — I'll open an infra task to add a filter that strips env vars and HTTP headers with that marker for deploy agents. linking INF-2770.

alex.k: thanks everyone — executing now. will update INF-2768 when done. :thumbsup:
